QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] The Battle to Come
QuestInfo.0: A lot has happened recently. Time to report everything to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.1: A lot has happened recently. Time to report everything to Neinheart.
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart was pleased that you collected so much of the ancient gods' power and that you made contact with the Primacy. However, he expressed concerns over the battle to come and the #rgreat selection#k. With all this in mind and the ever-changing situation, you can't help but feel that you might face Darmoor in the not-so distant future.
